name: Tetrahedral Ray Marching
aliases: Differentiable rendering in a tetrahedral mesh
definition: A ray-marching algorithm for non-uniform tetrahedral grids that projects vertices to find exit faces and includes camera centers in the mesh for efficient entry point identification.
summary: Tetrahedral Ray Marching is a ray traversal method for non-uniform tetrahedral grids that uses explicit geometric traversal and SDF interpolation to efficiently identify ray entry and exit points.
